title: Jain Friendly Indulgent Middle Eastern Cheddar Cheese Skillet
description: A sour, springy, and indulgent Middle Eastern dish featuring cheddar cheese, made Jain-friendly and cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cast-iron skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they are tender.
Add the diced tomatoes, sumac, salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese and stir until it is melted and well combined with the vegetables.
Add the torn pita bread and stir until it is well coated with the cheese and vegetable mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
